name: @tradrl/adapter-news
description: News market-data adapter: declared source descriptor, documented public news item schemas (headline, publication time, ticker tagging, publisher ref), mapping tables with the declared publication-time availability policy and the embargo quartet policy (records held to their embargo instant), public + wire-service entitlement tiers as opaque refs, declarative rate quotas and the normalized session over an injected transport port (spec/ADAPTERS.md, Work Order T038). Zero runtime dependencies; provider semantics live here and nowhere else (L2/L13).
